title: CVD-risk-fs-ctgan
summary: Reproducibility code for a paper combining filter and wrapper feature selection with a tabular GAN to predict cardiovascular risk in diabetic patients from the Steno T1D dataset. The standalone ctgan package's CTGAN synthesizer is imported and run directly to oversample the minority class, with sdmetrics' QualityReport also imported for evaluation.
needs: QualityReport from sdmetrics is imported but no confirmed call site was present in the evidence; TVAE is imported but never instantiated in shown code.
